unresolved_call_decision_groups.rationale: The extractor follows caller-supplied detached validation/appraisal digests and exact raw-value fields through fail-closed identifier/digest validation and canonical JSON-to-SHA-256 integrity construction. Generic digest/evidence propagation conservatively collides with an unrelated archived restore helper that performs path.open/fh.read, but this validated-learning binding module imports no file or persistence surface and invokes no restore helper. The records only verify an already supplied validation-to-appraisal integrity chain and construct immutable detached evidence; they do not acquire training input, ingest raw social feedback, poll hardware, train or update a model, write memory, read persistence, emit expression, install runtime capture, or grant authority.
unresolved_call_decision_groups.denial_semantics: Fail-closed validation/appraisal digest rejection and local integrity hashing are audit-visible validation only. They grant no runtime read, training mutation, memory write, raw-social ingestion, hardware polling, persistence access, expression path, observation-window transition, cutover, or M3-E authority.
